title: Key=value pairs
hints: Split the line on ";" with strings.Split, then handle each piece on its own.
strings.Cut(piece, "=") splits at the first "=" only, so a value like "a=b" survives. Its third result says whether there was an "=" at all. Use strings.TrimSpace on both halves.
for _, seg := range strings.Split(line, ";") { k, v, ok := strings.Cut(seg, "="); k = strings.TrimSpace(k); if !ok || k == "" { continue }; m[k] = strings.TrimSpace(v) }
